## 12. Methods, coverage, bibliography and reproducible appendices

[method] Evidence boundary and source hierarchy. The factual boundary is the approved, validated merged graph selected by the explicit partition index. Discovery candidates, provisional reviews, search snippets and unpinned working files do not become report facts. Primary creator papers, official repository/card versions, provider policies, audited statements and first-party case accounts retain their source type. Provider marketing is reported as a disclosure. A source-content review checks whether an exact claim is supported; it does not transform self-reported operations into an independent audit.

[method] Assertion approval and review identity. Each approved assertion has exact-content author, source-verifier and adversarial receipts from separate actual AI invocations. Approval binds wording, subject, predicate, object or typed value, qualifications, source version, locator and excerpt digest. Report-level evidence-auditor and adversarial reviews are separate requirements bound to the exact report digest and complete graph digest. Prior report or graph reviews cannot approve this expanded synthesis. No fabricated human reviewer, honorific, institutional endorsement or review receipt is added.

[method] Original-stage notes and current status. Frozen source packets can retain author-only or proposal-stage wording from their original creation. Those notes are preserved as historical provenance; current assertion status and exact-digest three-role receipts determine admission. Superseded original assertions remain candidates, and new approved replacements retain their actual source and review dates. This synthesis incorporates qualified wording changes, not only ID substitutions. In particular, an admitted paper or family does not erase source conflicts, unread spans, experiment-reproduction limits or unresolved rights.

[method] Reading depth. full_source is a bounded editorial category: methods plus main results or worked examples and limitations, with separately recorded spans. It does not mean all appendices or proofs were read, every experiment reproduced or all corpus records checked. A truthful full_document_read false is compatible with adequate bounded main-section review. Abstract-only material cannot be promoted through a claim count. Dataset construction may be reviewed through creator methods and documentation without adding the original paper work as a fully reviewed paper or establishing corpus-byte identity.

[method] Capture-specific evidence. Cogito and Mindy observations bind the exact saved official extracted-page snapshots available to the reviewers; origin HTML and live HTTP status were not exposed by that extraction. Separate direct retrieval attempts had their own failures and do not turn the extraction into a verified live-origin response. The Mindy FAQ is undated, so current staffing/location figures are not adopted. TrustScale’s rebrand article was decoded from the pinned public application bundle rather than established by rendered-page execution. These capture boundaries remain attached to the underlying source records and dossier limitations.

[method] Version and identity accounting. A paper work counts once through its reviewed manifestation; a dataset or benchmark family counts once through approved family/release evidence. Formats, configs, splits and subset releases do not add families. FineWeb-Edu is currently one FineWeb subset release, correcting the initial eight-family baseline’s separate-family treatment without changing that archive’s bytes. MuSiQue’s new human-composed questions support one family; inherited seed corpora and answerability/serialization variants do not add families. Corporate aliases and product brands do not automatically add suppliers.

[method] Reproduction snapshot. This authoring report binds the complete partitioned load_graph result at canonical JSON SHA-256 2a7364f8adb6887fd8b005c7e8013d6ebaec9f10f29c320aa28fac91022d14ed, graph input release research-2026-11-11.candidate.1, and graph as_of 2026-11-12T17:50:15.040816Z. The report release research-2026-11-12.1 is independently versioned from that evidence input. Canonical dataset version 2.5.0 retains file SHA-256 948e69229fa24a4a1e6b5eed6d9c11570568a3c05bf9512e442d19611061a061. Recompute the graph digest after load_graph validates the approved-partition index and canonical bytes. The actual frozen-core identity digest is a413cd22ee5dceb633d2495e3d1bc592e75a15ca6ffd82f2f95beea8d119e5b4, frozen_on 2026-11-12T17:42:16.963477Z, with captured-source cutoff 2026-11-12T17:32:13.289438Z. These identifiers describe the research inputs and authoring provenance; archived-edition identity and public availability require the separately verified publication receipt. A graph, cutoff, release-identity or prose change requires fresh exact synthesis review bindings.

[method] Computed coverage appendix. Coverage method 1.3.0 counts 2,548 approved, 195 candidate and 39 historical assertions. There are 3,261 scoped source records, of which 3,260 are captured, representing 783 distinct captured document versions under the version/response-hash rule. The selected qualifying corpus has 73 supplier groups, 225 distinct reviewed paper works, 85 dataset families and 87 benchmark families. All 39 legacy organizations have bounded inclusion audits and 38 have conclusive dispositions; BenchFlow remains commercially pending. Operating brands such as Clickworker/LXT and Nexdata/Datatang are retained without extra group counts. The 416-unit frozen core has 389 deep dispositions and 27 outstanding deep-review gaps. The numerator and denominator are source-qualified inventory units, not all discoveries, all scientifically reviewed works, all potential supplier artifacts or the world market.

[method] Relationship appendix. Exactly 225 approved assertions use explicit object relationships. Other observations use source-bound typed values. Predicates are nontransitive: parent links support work/family counting only, and group identifiers deduplicate supplier coverage without extending every brand claim to every subsidiary. Software use, funding, contributor affiliation and expert recruitment do not establish unstated data-supply contracts, exclusive authorship, contribution shares or causal supplier performance.

[method] Launch gate appendix. The fixed floors require 39 completed legacy inclusion audits, 60 qualifying suppliers, 150 reviewed paper works, 60 dataset families, 20 benchmark families and disposition of at least 90% of a frozen eligible core. Commercial dispositions are separate; BenchFlow’s pending status does not invalidate its completed inclusion audit. The current bounded frozen core is 416 and its 389/416 deep-disposition rate exceeds the unchanged 90% floor. The source-bound actual finite 200-hypothesis reference audit is accepted against the unchanged 98% precision and 95% recall thresholds with no critical false attribution. The distinct screening audit must recover at least 190 of 200 eligible records and at least 90% in each major stratum. Numerical coverage and an authoring validation do not complete screening, synthesis review, source-cutoff, privacy, archive or technical requirements.

[method] Audit status and limitations. The accepted actual reference panel contains 185 true positives, zero false positives, seven false negatives and eight true negatives. Precision is 185/(185+0) = 1.0 and recall is 185/(185+7) = 0.9635416667. These quantities evaluate the disposition of original source-bound first-peer hypotheses in that finite panel. They do not estimate extraction recall, discovery recall, population recall or the precision of all final corrected outputs. Fifteen inputs were actually withheld, including seven supported opportunities. Original hypotheses, failed earlier validation, truth/prediction records, correction history and genuine review outcomes remain retained. No screening recovery or pass is inferred from the reference result; publication requires the separate accepted, dated exact screening result in the edition audit downloads. Accessible English-language and well-documented material remains overrepresented. The publication state of this exact report/graph pair is recorded separately in the verified edition metadata.

[method] Search and selection bias. This is a selected public-source corpus rather than a probability sample. English-language material, public research artifacts and providers with detailed documentation are easier to discover and inspect. Confidential contracts, unavailable or blocked documents, undocumented suppliers and unobserved language/domain intersections can be missing. Unknown fields are preserved as unknown and do not count as evidence of absence. The report’s comparisons are sample-limited and should not be extrapolated into the entire market.

[method] Source dates and cutoff. published_on records an established source publication date, captured_on its actual capture, reviewed_on its actual review and assertion as_of its declared observation date. This refresh retains those input dates and binds the actual frozen-core captured-source cutoff 2026-11-12T17:32:13.289438Z. Later source-content review can assess a pre-cutoff captured version without relabeling capture time. The first actual edition may follow only after all existing gates pass under the coordinator’s matching one-time launch authorization. Later editions return to Friday 17:00 Pacific cutoffs and Monday 09:00 Pacific publication targets. Delayed work, captures, archive confirmations and public activation are never backdated.

[method] Interpretation and reproducible calculations. Approved counts are computed from qualifying identities and current approved assertions. Sample ratios should identify numerator and denominator before rounding. Project cost and acceptance formulas in chapter 8 are proposed methods with no invented inputs. Paper-reported results in the atlas retain the exact task, version and measurement condition described by the approved statement; they are not independently reproduced results, current model rankings or estimates of supplier performance. No metric is averaged across incompatible benchmark protocols.

[method] Public reuse and downloads. The research hub is https://sciencetostartup.com/research/; the living report route is https://sciencetostartup.com/research/state-of-ai-data-labs/; the evidence and download index is https://sciencetostartup.com/research/data/; source-backed review and correction entry is https://sciencetostartup.com/review/. Download links in the prepared publication must bind its own JSON/CSV/SQLite, schemas, bibliography, checksum manifest, offline evidence appendix, PDF and reproduction package. This source report does not assert that the expanded matching package, DOI, Zenodo archive or Hugging Face mirror already exists.

[method] Publication and corrections. Website preparation, deployment, archive confirmation and mirror synchronization have separate states and receipts. Accounts remain prepare-only under the current policy. A source-backed correction should identify the claim or report block, the source version and locator, the proposed wording and the reason. The research workflow reviews support, privacy and identity before integrating changes. Historical frozen packages retain pinned bytes; a correction belongs in a new version and change log rather than an invisible replacement.

[method] Bibliography reading guide. The entries below provide the reviewed paper-work title, a source URL from its bound evidence and the inspected source version. Claim links carry the exact locator, excerpt hash, qualifications and review identities. A source URL can resolve to a later page; the recorded version and response digest define the reviewed content. Dataset and supplier bibliography records are available through each atlas/dossier’s claim bindings and the evidence ledger; no external affiliation is used as a substitute for a documented contribution.

[method] Formal audit boundaries. The actual reference audit and its independent admission exist separately from this author invocation; the author supplies no new gold labels, evaluated predictions or independent audit approval. Screening is a distinct edition-level audit. No author-only diagnostic, historical screening attempt, family count or reference-panel result establishes its completion. An actual later screening result must bind its own frozen membership, source-bound independent adjudications and evaluated input, with dated exact results supplied in the edition audit downloads. A changed report wording or method addendum requires its own exact synthesis review.

[method] Author/reviewer separation. This refresh is report authorship over existing approved research inputs. It does not create new primary-source reads, source-content review receipts or launch-audit evidence. The later evidence-auditor and adversarial synthesis invocations must assess the exact revised prose against this graph. This author provides no pass on their behalf.

[method] Source-binding correction history. The current correction ledger contains 151 records and preserves earlier history. This refresh uses the selected approved successors for 84 distinct quarantined claim IDs and records a prose/qualification decision for each of the 141 affected old paragraphs. Original candidates and earlier positive/negative receipts are unchanged. Source qualifications can retain original proposal-stage notes; current approved status and actual exact-content receipts determine current admission, while the scientific limitations remain. The unsupported Dataocean general-offer/legal-alias inference stays withheld. Correction history is not a substitute for the pending separate exact synthesis reviews.

[method] Locator reproduction. A locator identifies pinned source bytes and an extraction convention. One-based physical PDF pages differ from printed labels; global marked-text lines count markers and blank lines, while per-page pdftotext-layout coordinates use their declared physical page and tool convention. Preserve source versions, raw-response hashes and supplied derived-text hashes before interpreting a line range. Dataset-card revisions document the inspected card and do not automatically identify every corpus shard. A successful re-extraction is reproducibility evidence, rather than a new capture, scientific finding or independent content review.

[method] Bounded core admission and discovery scope. The actual complete-inventory independent scope certificate has SHA-256 49a6561fa9dc40829623cb368d8bd093587126e29e2ee5641f1658d039682783; the accepted stable-identity join has SHA-256 b04e8172f6dc429f82116c91dbbb9bdf9c5e6cdbe9f758d62273ae8a0e33771a. The coordinator subsequently coapproved and actually applied the freeze. Their 532 retained named targets resolve to 416 source-qualified logical units: 84 mandatory organization-audit units, 160 paper works, 85 dataset families and 87 benchmark families. The remaining target states are 102 Unknowns, thirteen nonunit aliases or manifestations and one source-results container. Eligibility is determined independently of scientific completion or achieved coverage. A fully reviewed scientific paper can remain outside this source-qualified denominator; this is why 225 scientifically reviewed works and 160 inventory paper identities are different measures. No prior source proof, failed route, negative review or unresolved target is erased by the 416-unit freeze.

[method] Admission routes and counting rule. Route A requires a captured official intended-supplier direct artifact link and concrete data-workflow relevance. Route B requires creator-primary evidence of a distinct named family or evaluation protocol. Route C requires primary reusable-method evidence and an independently authored field-level origin, reference-method or reusable-baseline designation. Route D is configured intended-supplier/legacy audit membership, with commercial qualification decided separately. A bibliography occurrence, title, scientific completion or corporate byline is insufficient by itself. Shared authors are disclosed rather than subjected to a universal all-author-disjoint rule. Reused examples do not by themselves defeat a separately defined family; releases, aliases, mirrors, formats and subsets do not automatically create one. These are the accepted inventory-policy rules, not new scientific approvals.

[method] Retained discovery frontiers. The complete scope record preserves 145 discovery partitions and all 97,307 original discovery rows, 125 creator-root records and 27 foundation-source functions. The retained foundation accounting includes 3,167 citation occurrences, 134 explicit designation tasks, 87 group designation tasks and 53 identity-precision holds. Each partition retains its query, cursor/capture state, errors and pending action rather than being relabeled complete when a bounded named membership is accepted. The 85-record supplier roster and its known, pending and restricted function URLs are also retained. The 416 resolved identities are a bounded source-qualified subtotal; unresolved pagination, linked child artifacts, private catalogs, missing functions and unexamined queries remain open. No finite capacity envelope is an upper bound on the literature or on inaccessible commercial stock.

[method] Function scope remains bounded. The later captured metadata decisions for micro1, AfterQuery, BenchFlow, Mercor and HackerRank approve only their exact observed listing, controls, UI states or named membership routes. They do not close whole research, creator, supplier or foundation functions. Earlier failed captures and unread panels remain historical unknowns at their original scope. Newly observed UI states form a separate later layer. A contact-form Next control does not prove research pagination, and an empty-state string coexisting with populated cards is not an exclusion. Nested identity, scientific reading, access and rights tasks remain separate from listing enumeration.

This is a known-reference post-remediation repeat, not an unseen holdout or an estimate of population precision, discovery recall, final supplier qualification or market-wide performance. ## Evidence and reproduction

The accompanying clean-dataset.json, CSV and SQLite contain the same versioned public projection. Canonical dataset 2.5.0 remains unchanged outside this archive. Contact details and raw source text are excluded from this projection. Review receipts describe actual scope. corrections.json records accepted correction metadata and approved replacements; evidence.html preserves superseded IDs without unapproved wording. Candidate assertions and metadata-only discoveries are excluded from approved evidence; completed inclusion audits may leave commercial qualification unresolved.

Open evidence.html for offline entity dossiers, a recorded-scope comparison table, assertions, source bindings and review receipts. Use MANIFEST.json to verify each file's SHA-256. The archive is self-contained and makes no network requests. Source URLs and identifiers are retained in the accompanying public graph.
